purpose: Validate CaDynamics_E2 with imposed calcium current, then CaDynamics_E2 -> SK_E2 at imposed voltage before any Task32 electrical feedback.
negative_control: A zero-calcium-current arm must remain near its no-injection trajectory. Pulse arms must visibly differ from the paired rest arm; a null perturbation renders the experiment uninformative, not successful.
decision: IV-B1 must pass independently before interpreting IV-B2. IV-B2 must pass before preparing Task32 closed electrical feedback. Failure of native/formula timing or clamp semantics is a technical mismatch requiring diagnosis, not evidence against learned gates. No trained calcium surrogate or acceleration claim.
scope: One compartment, imposed calcium current through an auditable diagnostic NMODL current writer. CaDynamics_E2 and SK_E2 canonical mechanisms. Fixed-step NEURON, imposed voltage for IV-B2; no autonomous V, morphology, synapses, axial coupling, Ca reversal dynamics or speed claim.
